verification.subject: Confirm your e-mail for monki trips

password_reset.subject: Reset your monki trips password
password_reset.text:
Hi {name},

Someone asked to reset the password of your account. Open this link to choose a new one:
{url}

The link works once, for 60 minutes. If it was not you, ignore this message: your password has not changed.

invitation.subject: {tripName}: you are invited to plan the trip together
invitation.text:
{inviterName} invited you to join the trip "{tripName}" on monki trips.

Open this link to accept:
{url}

The invitation works for 7 days.
